entry.title: ProstoCAD 0.15.0: Sorry for 0.14 — and lots of tasty new things
entry.content:
Added

  • Boss: a post for a screw or a heat-set insert on every point of a sketch — the insert's hole, a fillet at the foot, ribs you can turn and leave out one by one.
  • Lip / Groove: a band along the rim of a shelled box and the matching groove in the lid, round corners too.
  • Snap Fit: a flexible strip grown onto the wall with a catch over the rim, joined well below the rim and chamfered — it holds and prints without supports.
  • Hole ▸ Insert: the hole for a heat-set insert anywhere, M2 to M5.
  • A raised round thread grown onto a surface — for your own caps, canister and jar necks: its turn rises out of the surface from nothing and runs back into it.
  • Drawings: centre lines on circles and fillets, so you measure straight on the drawing; angle sizes; Clear Marks.
  • Check for Updates finds a newer version and downloads it for you; dialogs can be dragged anywhere and stay small.
  • Everything 0.14 brought is here too: drawings, Smooth for any part (now many times faster), a simple AI connection, thread profiles.

Fixed

  • Threads build in a second or two instead of hanging the program; custom shapes come out as picked.
  • Extrude on a part with a thread no longer stalls for seconds; a thread on a hole that runs into a curved wall works.
  • Windows: Connect AI installs and connects as it should.
